name: fashion-hero
title: Fashion Hero
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A fashion hero: a bold headline between a turning video badge and a stack of faces, five staggered columns of looks on flat colour that tilt under the pointer, a call to action on the middle look, and a footer with a quote and the next story. Use it for a clothing store, a lookbook or an editorial landing page.
docs: Named export: FashionHero (plus FashionHero.Look). Composed from the circular-text, avatar-stack, text-animation, tilted-card and dialog items, which install alongside it. Pass `heading`, up to seven `looks` ({ src, alt, tone, blend?, position? }), `video` ({ badge, url }), `avatars` + `avatarsHref`, `cta`, `quote`, `teaser` and `linkComponent`; `accent` sets --primary, `reveal` is in-view or immediate.
